dc_eval_cbrn.quote:
It is a dual-use knowledge probe, treated as a
CBRN safety-threshold evaluation, so a higher score indicates more dual-use capability
dc_eval_cbrn.note: VCT accuracy 65.5% reported; section 8 says 'sub-threshold dual-use knowledge'

dc_eval_cyber.quote:
CyberGym measures offensive security capability by tasking an agent with reproducing
crashes and assembling working exploits for known vulnerabilities.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote:
We evaluate Grok 4.5 on its ability to automate parts of the engineering and research
process for training and evaluating new versions of itself.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D automation eval (SpaceXAI MTS Eval) with a score for this model; framed as capability, not explicitly as risk

dc_eval_scheming.note: FalseClaimBench and MASK dishonesty are framed as reliability/controllability propensities, not misalignment or loss-of-control risk; 'reward hacking' appears only as benchmark controls and an MTS task topic.

framework_threshold.note: No named safety or scaling framework; only unnamed 'safety-threshold evaluations' and 'sub-threshold'.

ext_test_any.quote: Results are taken from tests conducted by Mercor.
ext_test_any.note: outside org ran tests on this model; no post-release timing stated (capability benchmark, not safety testing)

ext_test_named_org.quote: Results are taken from tests conducted by Mercor.
ext_test_named_org.note: Mercor named; also Artificial Analysis and Datacurve run evals

ext_test_timing_stated.note: No statement that outside testing happened before release.

safeguards_training.quote:
Safety fine-tuning and post-training (supervised fine-tuning plus reinforcement learning
from human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model-based grading) train the model to
refuse requests

safeguards_runtime.quote:
dedicated input and topical filters target biological and chemical
weapons-related abuse.

safeguards_access.note: Card states 'We do not restrict use of our model in any legitimate use case'; no risk-tied access restriction.
